_how: GAMES OF THE DAY: the big carousel at the very top of box.pulseform.org, with Trending right under it. Put 3 to 6 game ids in 'default' (the id is the name of the game's file in public/games, without .html). To plan a specific day, add a line like "2026-11-08": ["turbo-laps", "dead-air"]. That day shows those instead. Edit this file on GitHub and save: the next deploy picks it up.
